argv: run-as com.cooper.lithic.m22verify.debug sh -c 'printf '"'"'M22_END_JOURNEY_ROOTS_BEGIN\n'"'"'; id -u; for p in no_backup/m22-ui-journey-*; do if [ -e "$p" ] || [ -L "$p" ]; then stat -c '"'"'ROOT=%n|%u|%i|%s|%Y|%f'"'"' "$p"; fi; done; printf '"'"'M22_END_JOURNEY_ROOTS_END\n'"'"''
privacy: Exact USB serial retained only in ignored control. Filtered full output processed in memory; raw bytes/SHA refer to complete command output.
